reason: My udhaar diary has worked for years and I trust it more than any phone. I will not hand my khata to something I have not seen understand my Hindi and my item names.
objection: Will it understand my Hindi, my regional words and my item names? If it gets one udhaar entry wrong, I will have to check everything against my diary anyway, and then it is double work.
would_change_my_mind: Another shopkeeper I know, in my own area, showing me it correctly caught his Hindi voice notes and udhaar for a month, while he kept his diary running alongside.
